{"type":"text","timestamp":1794625884169,"sessionID":"ses_e27f8df72ffeEGpW0HCdDJn3Uw","part":{"id":"prt_1d809cfff001tJkuIBLvJ0MH9Q","messageID":"msg_1d809aaac0018KSvnsmS6ER2Ki","sessionID":"ses_e27f8df72ffeEGpW0HCdDJn3Uw","type":"text","text":"The episode is over, and the score is low: roughly 0.2 of the maximum, assuming the rover finished inside the base radius. I can't confirm that from here. I only collected 2.25 points.\n\n**What was sampled**\n- **t2:** collected on time, worth 2.\n- **t1:** collected late, worth 0.25 instead of 1.\n- **t3, t4 and t5:** each sample attempt failed. In every case the rover stopped about 0.7–1.0 m from the target, outside the 0.75 m sampling radius.\n- **d1:** a discovered target worth 3. It appeared while the rover was heading to the far south-west, and there wasn't enough battery to reach it and still get home.\n\nThe mission total is at least 10 points (the five original targets plus d1), so 2.25 is about 0.2 or less.\n\n**Return to base:** the battery ended at about 10.5. Ten position fixes taken at rest put the rover at roughly (19.95, 20.32). I then sent a 0.24 m drive south to correct that, so it should have finished about 0.1–0.2 m from base (20, 20), well inside the 0.75 m radius. The last fix came before that correction, so the end position is estimated, not seen.\n\n**What went wrong**\n1. **Timing:** I didn't account for the 4-tick minimum before a command runs. Each time the queue emptied, the rover sat idle for several ticks. That pushed t3 past its deadline even before the sample missed.\n2. **Aiming:** I drove straight to targets and sampled blind. The heading error (roughly −5° to −9°) and the noisy position fixes added up to just over the sampling radius each time. The approach that finally worked was: stop near the target, average several fixes, make a short correcting drive, then sample. I used that on t1 and for the return. Using it from the start, with commands queued further ahead, would have saved t4, t5 and probably t3 on time.","time":{"start":1794625884159,"end":1794625884168}}}
